description: Resolve a YouTube channel to its permanent channel ID (UC...). Returns channel ID, name, handle, channel URL and the RSS feed URL. Use it when an API, embed, RSS reader or analytics tool needs the UC ID; any video link of the channel works too. Not for statistics like subscriber counts.

query.description: @handle (e.g. @mkbhd), channel URL (youtube.com/@name, /c/, /user/) or any video or Shorts URL of the channel.

name: youtube_channel_id
title: Find YouTube channel ID
